description: Source code for data formatting functions related to the 'rocket' UI component in the game, including resolution display, server ping, player info, and team status, with registration and dispatch mechanisms.

classes.name: dataFormatterCmd_t
classes.description: Structure representing a data formatter command with name and execution function.

methods.name: GCD
methods.description: Calculates the greatest common divisor of two integers.

methods.name: DisplayAspectString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the aspect ratio of given width and height, simplifying the ratio.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_DFResolution
methods.description: Formats and displays resolution information based on provided data.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_DFServerPing
methods.description: Formats and displays server ping in milliseconds.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_DFServerPlayers
methods.description: Formats and displays server player counts.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_DFPlayerName
methods.description: Formats and displays a player's name with HTML span styling.

methods.name: ScoreFromClientNum
methods.description: Retrieves score data for a given client number.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_DFGearOrReady
methods.description: Displays gear or readiness status for a client, depending on game state.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_FormatData
methods.description: Dispatches data formatting commands based on raw data received.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_RegisterDataFormatters
methods.description: Registers all data formatter commands for use.
